title: Sales, conversion and ad spend review
lead: Sales are up 9× a day on September. Ad spend is 63% of sales, and each ad-driven sale costs ~$29 on a $27 product. The fix: move spend to the searches that convert, and move the listing to Makeup Sets.

bullets: US: 2.5%, in line with W7's other US gift sets.
UK (Make-up Sets): ~5%. Same product, images and reviews.
"make up advent calendar 2026": 1 in 12 clicks, 1 in 8 purchases.

category.callout:
Recommendation: move to Makeup Sets.
  • Beauty searches: already visible.
  • Broad searches ("advent calendar 2026"): converts at a third of the market rate.
  • Makeup Sets brings more beauty-intent traffic and makes it eligible for a Best Seller badge.
  • The UK listing, in Make-up Sets, converts at ~5%.

sections.listing: No issues. 7 zoomable images, video, mobile-friendly A+, 5,300+ reviews at 4.4★, 99% Buy Box.

push_notes: Organic: page one (#1–10) on most beauty, makeup and teen searches. Page 2–3 on broad searches.
Paid: over half of ad spend lands at the top of search, the most expensive placement at $38 per order.
"beauty advent calendar" has taken $4,100 at $49 per order. Hold the bid and let the 2026 terms take the budget.
campaign_notes: Ads plus the price cut lifted organic sales from ~7 to ~41 a day.
Every campaign spends more than $20 per $27 calendar.
Spend up ~3× in two weeks. The latest week returned $0.95 per $1.
spend_notes: 37% of spend went on generic "advent calendar" searches at ~$50 per order. "advent calendar 2026" alone: $8,185 for 173 orders.
Searches for Amazon's own calendar: ~$70 per order.
placement_notes: Over half of spend already goes to the top of search, with no top-of-search adjustment set. It's the most expensive placement.
Worst single spot: the general campaign at the top of search, $56 per order.
Low top-of-search share (2–7%) reflects how big these searches are, not a lack of spend there.
rank_notes: Yes, up to a point. Rank improved ~16× as spend scaled.
The biggest jump came in the week spend doubled and the price dropped. The two can't be separated.
Since 17 Oct the rank has held at ~6,300–6,600 while spend runs at ~$2,000 a day. Extra spend is no longer buying rank.
Rank is measured in Home & Kitchen › Home Décor.

actions.title: General "advent calendar" campaign: cut from $1,000 to ~$200 a day.
actions.detail: Keep "advent calendar 2026" on exact match, low bid. Negatives: needoh, squishy, dumpling, chocolate, lego, for adults, amazon beauty advent calendar, amazon advent calendar.
actions.why: Saves ~$800 a day. Currently $43 per calendar.

actions.title: Green searches: exact match, raise bids on the cheapest-converting terms.
actions.detail: makeup advent calendar 2026 ($17 per order), make up advent calendar 2026 ($12), beauty advent ($12), luxury beauty advent calendar 2026 ($23). No blanket top-of-search boost.
actions.why: In the Beauty Blast keyword campaign, top of search costs $34 per order against $24 lower down the page.

actions.title: Competitors: expand product-page targeting
actions.detail: to the top Sephora, Ulta, e.l.f., L'Oréal and Revolution calendars. Brand-name searches: small test only.
actions.why: Rival calendars cost $60–95; W7's is $27. Product pages run at ~$23 per calendar today.

actions.title: Spanish: add
actions.detail: calendario de adviento maquillaje and calendario de adviento.
actions.why: ~42k searches a week. Page one. Ratio 1.9–4.1×.

actions.title: Placements: lower bids where top of search runs above target.
actions.detail: Start with the general campaign ($56 per order at the top of search).
actions.why: Rest of search sells at $26 per order; top of search at $38.

actions.title: Category: open a Seller Support case to move the calendar and Holiday Haul to Makeup Sets.
actions.why: Better traffic match. Best Seller badge eligibility.

targets.measure: Ad spend as a share of total sales
Calendars sold per day without an ad
Ad cost per order, top of search

summary: the product, price and reviews are working, but the ad budget is going to the wrong searches. Cut broad and off-target spend. Put the budget into the beauty searches and rival product pages that sell for under $25 an order. Move the category. Aim to finish before the late-November peak.
notes: Organic = total minus ad-attributed sales. Part of the growth is seasonal.
sources: Seller Central Business Reports, Brand Analytics, Amazon Ads, Keepa, Jungle Scout
